title: MicLength.mic_len contradicts the wire selector semantics
description: Correctness review finding (P3): python/src/lichen/link/frame.py:53-67 documents selector values 0 and 1 as compatibility-only and no MIC for unsigned frames, but the public MicLength.mic_len property returns 4 and 8. Signed frames always carry 48 bytes independently of the selector (frame.py:133-135; spec/02-physical-link.md:203,246; test/vectors/mic_length_selector.json). A caller using this property for sizing or slicing will compute a wire layout the serializer/parser never emits. Remove/replace the property with profile-correct semantics (likely context-sensitive or no byte-length property) and add a regression asserting unsigned=0 and signed=48 for both selectors.
